annotations.title: Lookup Protocol or Token by Name

description: Resolve a protocol or token name to Pacta's verified record: canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (Base-EAS-attested vs RPC-observed only), and ready-to-use preflightArgs {chain, address} for pacta_check_preflight. 140 protocols + 12 briefs, answered in memory (no RPC). Free in every pricing mode.

caller_agent.description: Identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'custom-agent'). Optional attribution (omitted = 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets.

caller_purpose.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum).

query.description: Protocol or token name, symbol, slug or 0x address (e.g. 'Aave', 'Ethena', 'USDe', 'Moonwell', 'kUSD'). Empty or '*' lists what Pacta tracks.

requester_role.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data).
